requirements: R1: Resolve cascading runtime environment launch failures including connection errors, backup directory mapping errors, and database migration dependencies

slices.title: Repair docker environment initialization and database migrations
slices.jtbd: When implementing the environment repair for this epic, I want to fix the docker configurations and flyway migrations, so that the product launches successfully.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a fresh clone of the repository, When docker-compose up is executed, Then the backup container maps its script directory correctly without creating an invalid directory.
Given the database is initializing, When the flyway migrations execute, Then the strains table dependency is resolved and migrations succeed.
Given the backend service starts, When it attempts to connect, Then it successfully establishes connections to all required services without connection refused errors.
